description: Return a very large share of what they buy; few orders and inactive for a long time.
suggested_action: Find out why they return (quality, wrong orders); avoid expensive campaigns until this is clear.

description: Bought recently and their spending is growing fast.
suggested_action: Nurture them: welcome series, cross-sell suggestions, encourage the next order.

description: Buy from time to time; the last order was months ago and their spending is going down.
suggested_action: Act now: reminder emails and a targeted offer before they leave.

description: Placed one order a long time ago and never came back; lowest spend.
suggested_action: Low-cost reactivation (one email or a small first-order-back offer); do not invest heavily.

description: Buy almost only on weekends and have not ordered for a long time.
suggested_action: Win them back with weekend-timed offers and reminders.

description: Buy often and recently, spend the most, buy many different products. Lowest churn.
suggested_action: Reward them: loyalty benefits, early access to new products, ask for referrals. Avoid unnecessary discounts.
